lines.zh: 脚踝歪着，走一步响一声。
行尸缓慢移动，每一步都艰难。
腐烂的行尸，拖着沉重的脚步。
腐烂的肉体拖着缓慢的步伐。
蹒跚而行，脚步沉重如石。
腐烂脚步声在寂静中回荡。
缓慢而行，每一步都是痛苦。

lines.en: Variant thirteen, one shoulder out of joint.
Every third step, its knee clicks.

lines.zh: 缓慢呼吸，腐肉轻微颤动。
腐肉轻轻颤动，无意识的生灵。
行尸呆滞，仿佛失去灵魂。
行尸盯着玩家，腐肉裂开。
lines.en: Walker stares at player, flesh splits.

lines.zh: 腐烂行尸，目光紧盯着玩家。
lines.en: Decaying walker, eyes fixed on player.

lines.zh: 行尸盯着玩家，腐肉翻动。
lines.en: Walker stares at player, flesh shifts.

lines.zh: 腐烂行尸，目光中的渴望。
行尸目光空洞，盯着玩家。
lines.en: Walker's hollow eyes fixed on player.

lines.zh: 腐肉翻滚，行尸盯着玩家。
lines.en: Flesh rolls, walker stares at player.
Black blood oozes from the wound

lines.zh: 饿得骨头都在响，站不稳了。
lines.en: So hungry my bones rattle; I cannot stand straight.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指伸向你，尝尝末地的滋味？
lines.en: Rotting fingers reach for you. Taste the Nether?

lines.zh: 饥饿的触手逼近，准备撕碎你的肉？
lines.en: Hungering tentacles approach, ready to rip your flesh?

lines.zh: 你身上有我想要的东西，过来吧。
lines.en: You have what I want. Come here.

lines.zh: 享受末地的馈赠，被腐烂包围。
lines.en: Enjoy the Nether's gift, surrounded by decay.

lines.zh: 加入我吧，一起终结这个世界。
lines.en: Join me, together end this world.

lines.zh: 你有我需要的肉，跟我来。
lines.en: You have the flesh I need. Follow me.

lines.zh: 被腐朽的欲望驱使，你逃不掉。
lines.en: Driven by corruption, you can't escape.

lines.zh: 享受这份末日的礼物，成为我和一员。
lines.en: Enjoy this Nether gift, join me.

lines.zh: 腐烂是唯一的出路，选择我吧。
lines.en: Decay is the only escape, choose me.

lines.zh: 尝尝末地的美味，腐烂的灵魂。
lines.en: Taste the Nether's delicacy, corrupt soul.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，必须清除。
lines.en: You're in my way, must be removed.

lines.zh: 你挡了我前进的路，抱歉了。
你撞掉了我半张脸，我不在意。
lines.en: You knock half my face loose; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 别挡路，否则我会不客气。
lines.en: Step aside, or I won't be polite.

lines.zh: 挡住我的路了，让我过去。
lines.en: Blocked my path, let me through.

lines.zh: 别挡住我，否则后悔莫及。
lines.en: Don't block me, or you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 给我让开，否则我会用暴力解决。
lines.en: Move for me, or I'll resolve by force.
Mate success, we are of the same kind.

lines.zh: 找个伴侣，共同生存下去。
我们需要一个伴侣，来增加我们的力量。
lines.en: Need a mate, to increase our strength.

lines.zh: 我们寻找生存的伙伴，加入我。
求偶时间，我们需要一个伴侣。
lines.en: Mate time, we need a partner.

lines.zh: 求偶成功，我们可以共存。

lines.en: Eat each other, need a partner.

lines.zh: 求偶成功，我们可以一起生存。
我们需要一个伴侣，来延续生命。
lines.en: Need a mate, to continue life.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肉让我行动迟缓。

lines.en: I can only rely on corpses.
There is breathing behind the iron fence.
The smell of blood drifts downwind.

lines.zh: 第十三号盯上的人，跑不远
lines.en: Whoever variant thirteen picks does not get far.
After the bite, you will slow down.
I will not shout; I will only close in.

lines.zh: 你的腿在发抖，我看到了
lines.en: Your leg is shaking; I saw it.
The old wound you carry helps me.
One step, two; no need to count.
You have backed into the wall.

lines.zh: 尸变的进程，比你想的快
lines.en: The turning moves faster than you think.
Blood in your boot will spoil your step.
I am in no hurry; rotten meat does not run.
The teeth under this rot are still solid.

lines.zh: 我掐住你的喉咙，指节咯咯响。
lines.en: I clamp your throat and my knuckles rattle.
Rotten flesh, and so are you!

lines.zh: 我的牙齿咬穿了你的皮甲。
lines.en: My teeth bite through your leather armor.
Skin tears; blood hits the bricks.

lines.zh: 一口咬在肩上，牙陷进去
lines.en: A bite in the shoulder, teeth sinking in.
I tear off a piece and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 指甲在你胸口划出三道
lines.en: Nails leave three lines across your chest.
Knocked down, your face against the ground.

lines.zh: 我压住你的手臂，你别动
lines.en: I pin your arm; do not move.
This bite goes deep and will scar.
Do you hear the bone creak?

lines.zh: 从土里爬起来，一身是泥。
lines.en: I rise from the dirt, caked in mud.

lines.zh: 坟头的土松了，我爬了出来。
lines.en: The grave soil loosens and I crawl out.

lines.zh: 从土里爬出来，天已经黑了。
lines.en: I clawed out of the soil after dark.

lines.zh: 我从墓园的浮土下拱出来。
lines.en: I push up through the loose soil of the graveyard.

lines.zh: 第十三号，在废墟里睁眼
lines.en: Variant thirteen opens its eyes in the ruins.
The config is still on, so I appear.
Out of the rotten heap, I push myself up.

lines.zh: 末世不挑地方，哪都能生
lines.en: The apocalypse picks no place; I spawn anywhere.
